basic_profile.bio: A 34-year-old graphic designer based in Seattle, WA, with a penchant for the eerie and the esoteric. I've been a longtime fan of Lovecraftian horror and enjoy discussing philosophical topics on TalkHeathen. My work in design gives me a keen eye for detail, which I apply to my hobbies, such as collecting rare horror memorabilia. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7-10 PM PST. In a long-term relationship with a fellow creative, often collaborating on art projects. Not a fan of spammy content and have a particular disdain for poor communication in online marketing.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies in graphic design, which I honed through a Bachelor of Fine Arts degree and over a decade of industry experience. Additionally, I've self-taught myself digital marketing strategies, focusing on email marketing. My interest in philosophy and horror literature is more of a personal pursuit, enriched by extensive reading and community discussions.
